Review of the release PR. Result: clean. I did not build. This is a read-only review of the diff and the git history.

Checks:
1. Files. The diff touches only `RECOMMENDED.md`, `docs/decisions/` (78 files deleted), `RELEASE_NOTES.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `Cargo.toml` and `Cargo.lock`. No code changes.
2. Version. `Cargo.toml` has one change, 0.23.0 to 0.24.0. `Cargo.lock` has 11 changes, all `version` lines, all 0.23.0 to 0.24.0. The release notes title says 0.24.0.
3. CHANGELOG. The diff adds 59 rows. For each row, the short sha is the first-parent merge commit of the named PR in `v0.23.0..83867fd71`. I found no mismatch. I compared the text with the `Changelog:` line for 10 PRs (#2253, #2504, #2492, #2486, #2532, #2490, #2368, #2386, #1689, #2513). The text agrees.
4. RELEASE_NOTES. The format claims are correct. `PROJECT_VERSION` is 69 at `origin/release/v0.24.0` and was 67 at v0.23.0. The code comments name v68 for #2441 (PR #2504) and v69 for #1517 (PR #2253). The commit 1e6d124e7 says "version 64" because the number changed later when the PR merged. This is not an error. The count line (92 PRs, 12 feat, 60 fix, 1 perf, 2 refactor) matches the merge list. The posted G-code claims agree with the CHANGELOG rows. I found no false claim.
5. RECOMMENDED.md has the heading `## v0.24.0 - decisions gathered at the cut` and the decision files appended. `docs/decisions/README.md` is kept.

Non-blocking notes:
- The CHANGELOG row for PR #1689 has `(PR #1689)` and no issue number. The PR has no issue, so this is correct.
- Some decision files in `RECOMMENDED.md` start with `# #870` and `# #1186` (one `#`), not `##`. This is cosmetic.
